messages:
emily: Heads up — planning to land PR #1984. Trying to avoid the Wed 22:00 UTC deploy blackout. CI's currently in queue: https://ci.redwood.dev/job/1984/45 :hourglass_flowing_sand: Can someone take a quick pass on the final approval or propose a short rebase window that won't conflict with the blackout?

dan: I can review in ~30m. If CI hangs, we should consider a soft-handshake: rebase onto current main and hold until after blackout starts.

marta: I'll run the flaky test locally now. If it's green I can approve. ETA 10–15m. Ping me @emily when you start the rebase.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: CI queue position 7 -> estimated start ~18 minutes. Blocking jobs: integration-matrix (macos/py38).

jia: If we need to move, prefer earliest possible window tomorrow morning 07:00 UTC. Less traffic. Also, we can set `auto-fallback: true` in rollout to avoid outage if rollout would hit blackout.

alex: Quick note — don't force-push after approvals unless the diff is tiny; it'll reset CI. Better: post a small fix as separate PR if possible.

emily: Thanks all. Marta let me know result. If tests are green + dan approves, i'll rebase at 3309991160 and push. Will add `auto-fallback: true` to the canary policy. cc @deploy-bot

marta: Local run ✅, flaky test passed. Leaving a comment with logs. Approving now :thumbsup:

dan: Reviewed, looks good. Approve. :eyes:

emily: Pushed rebase and small lint fix. CI link: https://ci.redwood.dev/job/1984/46. Fingers crossed. If anything blocks, we'll hold for the morning window. Thanks!
